newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Vympelkom may start Russia trade next week.
newsitem.headline: Vympelkom may start Russia trade next week.

text.p: Russian cellular phone network operator AO Vympelkom may begin trading on the Russian market next week, a trader at Renaissance Capital said on Monday, adding his firm would be a market maker for the shares.
Dmitry Kryukov, deputy head of equities trading administration at Renaissance, said the NAUFOR brokers' association had already approved the listing for the Russian Trading System market.

Vympelkom American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) trade in New York, but shares have not traded on Russian markets. Kryukov said the ADRs, which traded at $37.00 at 1615 GMT after $36 5/8 at close on Friday, represented four underlying shares.
